query: What metformin dose was shown to reduce HbA1c in the primary trial evidence for adults with type 2 diabetes?

pubmed.title: Metformin 1000 mg twice daily and HbA1c reduction
pubmed.summary: In adults with type 2 diabetes, metformin 1000 mg twice daily significantly reduced HbA1c compared with placebo. Lower doses of 500 mg twice daily produced smaller glycaemic effects.

cochrane.title: Cochrane review of metformin dosing in type 2 diabetes
cochrane.summary: Systematic review found that metformin at 1000 mg twice daily was associated with clinically meaningful HbA1c reduction. Dose titration from 500 mg was recommended to improve tolerability.

dailymed.title: Metformin hydrochloride tablet label — dosage
dailymed.summary: Recommended starting dose is 500 mg orally twice daily or 850 mg once daily. Maximum recommended daily dose is 2000–2550 mg depending on formulation.

recorded_brief:
## Key Findings
- Evidence shows metformin reduced HbA1c in type 2 diabetes.

## Bottom Line
- Metformin reduces HbA1c in adults with type 2 diabetes.
